## Où j'en suis
At the end of the last session the Fernhill SSO branch `daniel/saml-sso-fernhill` works end to end on staging: real SAML login against Fernhill's IdP succeeds after the short-RelayState fix, and JIT creates users as `viewer` via the merged #415. Group-to-role mapping plus the RelayState change sit in PR #421, still open, and everything is blocked on Fernhill IT adding the `groups` claim before Thursday's demo (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" open: per-tenant `saml_role_mapping`, applied on every login, 41 auth tests and the full suite green (source: ses-sso-3)
- [prochaine-étape] Daniel emails Fernhill IT to add the `groups` claim; their metadata is already loaded on staging (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] once the claim exists, add an admin test account next to `kestrel.test1`, then demo Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 ET (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] get #421 reviewed and merged (source: ses-sso-3)
- [essai-raté] full return URL as RelayState was refused by Fernhill's ADFS (MSIS7042, over the 80-byte cap); truncating was dropped because it breaks deep links (source: ses-sso-3)
- [essai-raté] Fernhill IT's request for an `analyst` default and IdP-initiated only was declined — no analyst role exists, `viewer` stays until Maya talks to them (source: ses-sso-3, src-slack-fernhill)
- [décision] short opaque RelayState id, return URL kept in Redis 10 min and deleted on use (source: s3-03, 6d0e2b8)
- [décision] `viewer` stays the default role and SP-initiated login stays on for the fernhill tenant (source: s3-07)
- [décision] new SAML users get `viewer`, least privilege for a bank (source: s1-05)
- [décision] SAML only for Fernhill, no OIDC, both login flows (source: s1-03)
- [décision] JIT only accepts the tenant's verified domains, unverified ones logged without the email (source: s2-03, src-pr415)
- [question] a note says SSO enforcement for the fernhill tenant lands Dec 1 — nothing in the fil confirms it (source: src-note-enforce)
